W1-2.headline: THE BASELINE. Ruler A satisfiable 77.3%% (537 judged) / 75.0%% (553 planned); Ruler D 86.4%% / 83.9%%. All-days A 69.8%%/68.0%%. Reproduced W1-1 BYTE-EXACT 640/640, 0 flips, at a different git SHA. CANONICAL DENOMINATOR RECOMMENDED: satisfiable-planned minus degenerate, n=553. Cross-seed spread 0.9pt on the shipping ruler (brief 0.4-0.5 is what a LOOSER ruler gives; Ruler D measures 0.47-0.56) => treat <3pts single-seed as unmeasured. Ruler D = +8.9pts net but costs 15-20 days on the carb floor and makes KETO WORSE (-2.1). A1 ADJUSTED (623 is judged, not all-planned). F1 ADJUSTED: 248/250-expressible REFUTED (18 provably infeasible, 0 in band under either ruler) but consequence holds (0 of 218 satisfiable). IMPOSSIBLE is a label not a proof: 10 of 32 produce a compliant day. 31s per full-fleet run => no budget excuse for stored baselines.

W3-4 must cite 92.6%%. Buckets sum EXACTLY (138 = 553-415) at every denominator/diet/tier/seed; largest is fat-over 48. NEW: CARB, not fat, is the largest overage MASS (20,495g over vs fat 8,594g) -- a fat-only trimmer leaves the bigger pile. B9 CONFIRMED and named: the worst offender scheduled last IS THE SNACK (snacks ship 1.6-2.3x their nominal fat share at every position; meals ~1.0 until pos 7) = direct evidence for C2. B8 must be SPLIT: meal-only unsolved is 0.0%% in both small bands (52/52 unsolved small slots are snacks) but meals-only fat overshoot is +172.9%%. B5 CONCLUSION REFUTED: a-priori geometry is 10.7 low / 55.7 high (5.35:1 AGAINST), and the search HALVES the skew -- the pantry is a first-order co-cause, so the fix cannot be objective-only.

W1-4.name: honesty-detection
W1-4.headline: ADJUDICATION: THE BRIEF WINS. The prompt premise is TRUE (diagnoseFromResult hardcodes feasible:false at mealSolver.js:443, one return, no true path) but its CONCLUSION IS REFUTED -- all three call sites are gated, so a converged run never reaches it. FALSE-SURRENDER RATE 0.00%% at all 3 seeds (prompt claimed 95.8%%); precision 100%%, recall 98.73%%; 171/171 converged runs correctly carry diagnosis:null. Silent misses: 1 (p233, the 0-slot config). Detection 18/18 = 100%% on the PROVABLE set; the 8 label-only misses CONVERGED so silence was correct. Reproduced E5 (silent half portion), E6 (4,623 kcal on a 2,000 kcal day, ZERO warnings -- worse than the brief 2,953), E7, D6 (by counterexample: a 4/4 in-band day the app calls unreachable), E9, E10. THE REAL DEFECT IS PERSISTENCE AND DISPLAY: no day-verdict column exists, genMeta is React state, TodayTab matches /warning/i on ZERO lines, and TodayTab draws fat as kind=floor so an over-fat day RENDERS AS A MET FLOOR. Inflation trap measured: +30.18pts free on judged, +0.00 on planned.

W2-1.name: repartition-practice
W2-1.headline: KEY INSIGHT: dayTolerance() IS ALREADY a Chebyshev norm on tolerance-normalised deviations -- the ruler is one Math.max from being the objective. Recommends augmented Chebyshev goal program (L-inf + rho*mean), NOT L2 -- and identifies L2-vs-Linf as the mechanism behind wls2 +14.74-with-more-warnings. Add NO runtime dep (no JS BVLS exists; glpk.js is GPL-3.0+WASM; NNLS cannot express the 2.0 ceiling); hand-roll ~120 lines scoring on ROUNDED grams; YALPS as test-only oracle. Guard = Fletcher-Leyffer filter acceptance on the violation VECTOR (fixes G4 by comparing LEVELS not band membership). Found 2 new bugs in brain/optimizer.js (:91 step size can exceed Lipschitz limit n-fold; :42 down-weights fat ~10000x = B3 in the second transcription). Says DO NOT move the 0.5x floor yet.

W2-2.name: selection-precedents
W2-2.headline: Frame CONFIRMED as set-partitioning/column-generation (crew pairing) BUT its precondition FAILS: candidate days are not columns -- usageCount is mutated through the sequential solve, so days are path-dependent. Recommends LNS/ruin-and-recreate instead. EXACT safety rule: objective is MODULAR (scoreWeek is a sum) => cherry-pick, check the repeat cap, and if it passes the result ATTAINS the oracle bound (provably optimal); 6 of 7 preconditions hold today. DERIVED CENTREPIECE: 20 attempts are worth m~2.46 independent ones (independent best-of-20 would be 89.8%%, observed 24.5%%) -- explains C6, C12 and 20->40 simultaneously. Predicts realised +0 to +3 pts (C7 already measured +0.00). Variety: replace the 0.35x multiplier with a CATEGORY QUOTA (a quota costs zero until it binds).

W2-3.name: vegan-snack-market
W2-3.headline: The target box is a FAT problem, not a protein problem: >=32.6%%E protein AND <=23.4%%E fat kills the entire nut/seed category by 3.4x. Exactly ONE calorie-carrying whole plant food clears unaided under the full soy+gluten+nut+peanut+sesame wall (sprouted lentils) and it FAILS the repo Atwater gate. Only working architecture = near-zero-fat pulse/vegetable base + nutritional yeast (single-ingredient, outside the T-1 blocked class). 12 dishes proposed, 11 wall-safe, all pass real checkAtwater, Pd 8.18-12.40 vs current vegan median 3.23 (2.5-3.8x lift). 14 of 17 box-clearing foods ALREADY in dev.db with zero recipe uses. NEW SAFETY FINDING -> TRIAGE T-3: peanut-allergic users are NOT protected from lupin (foodMatchesExclusionTerm(lupin,peanuts)===false); allergenTaxonomy.js:635 documents the cross-reaction in PROSE with no code consuming it; 3 lupin rows already in DB, inert today.

W2-4.name: competitor-teardown
W2-4.headline: ZERO of the THREE comparable products (Eat This Much, StrongrFastr, Prospre) publish any numeric plan-accuracy tolerance -- MacroFactor has no generator, Mealime has no day-level solve, so quote 0-of-3 not 0-of-5. StrongrFastr EXPLICITLY DISCLAIMS exact macro accuracy; Prospre promises hit your goals every time with no documented failure state; ETM publishes 80-90%% GROCERY efficiency and nothing for macros (they publish the number they are proud of). Mealime +/-20 kcal is the only explicit tolerance and it is on a FILTER that cannot fail. Showing a BAND is industry standard (5 of 6); Cut Protocol grading a band while DISPLAYING A POINT is the worst configuration -- the user cannot tell whether they passed. Red-on-over is the category default => amber is marketable divergence, and calm-amber-plus-explanation is a position NOBODY occupies. Delivered 3 constitution-compliant infeasibility copy blocks.

W2-5.name: weekly-metric
W2-5.headline: RESEARCH PLUS MEASUREMENT on the real 65 week-personas x 3 seeds. The proposed 7-day mean kcal +/-5%% HIDES 47 out-of-band days across 17 of 43 passing weeks with ZERO false alarms -- a pure concealment device; MAD recovers only 5 of 47 because failure is 83%% one-sided. kcal+protein headline is blind to 46-49%% of failing days. E11 measured directly: refusing the worst day of each week = +4.0pts on a judged-only denominator, -6.2pts on a fixed planned denominator => THE DENOMINATOR IS THE GAMING RESISTANCE. 7 days is statistically indefensible (95%% CI +/-28pts); no mature analogue uses <14 days (CGM 14, PDC 91, Basiotis 31+). RECOMMENDS 3-state day composition (in/over/short/both) over a denominator FIXED AT PLAN CREATION, 28-day window, no score anywhere. ENERGY AVERAGES, PROTEIN DOES NOT (median weekly protein ratio 1.0053 -- no surplus to bank). BLOCKED on E2: no day verdict is persisted.

W2-6.name: fresh-sweep
W2-6.headline: REFRAMES D-3 with measurement: the brief refuted a WIDTH claim, the prompt made a POSITION claim -- they argued past each other. Width matches Helms (33.11%% vs 33.3%%) so too-tight is dead; POSITION is wrong in BOTH directions -- graded ceiling below AMDR for 159/250, graded floor below AMDR for 199/250, and 232/250 personas are graded COMPLIANT BELOW THE ENGINE OWN ESSENTIAL-FAT FLOOR (0.2475 vs ESSENTIAL_FAT_PER_LB_LBM 0.30). The +4.0/+5.0 figure does NOT bound a floor ruler (19%% vs 90%% loosening). But a PURE floor ruler FAILS on nutrition: implicit ceiling = 53.0%%E median, 250/250 above AMDR => re-anchor the ceiling to %%E, do not delete it. fatMid is fixed in grams while targetKcal falls => prescribed fat %%E RISES as the cut deepens, backwards from every source. Contrarian B PARTLY HOLDS: selection binds before portioning; 0.25x floor should be KILLED on literature (lowest measured normal portion = 70%% of reference; sub-norm portions trigger COMPENSATORY EATING). BRAIN=off confirmed MORE right in 2026 (every measured LLM study shows fat-over/carb-under/non-reproducible = same direction as the bug). No macro-compliance benchmark exists.
